triage.note: D10 defect 3, postmortem shape S2 again. The extracted item's text container rendered as a bare `<pre class="text">` (and, in Markdown mode, a bare `<div class="text md">`) — role `generic`, no name — so the pane holding the actual filing text was invisible to an accessibility-first reader. Watched red against the unmodified file: four failures, `class="text md": role is None, want 'region'` / `class="text md": no accessible name naming the item` / `class="text": role is None, want 'region'` / `class="text": no accessible name naming the item`. Green once both carry role=region and an aria-label interpolating `${esc(it.item)}`. BOTH containers are pinned deliberately: they are the same slot in two view modes (ADR-032), so naming only the `<pre>` would let Markdown mode silently regress the fix. The label must INTERPOLATE the item code — a constant label would name all 23 items the same, which is the ambiguity shape this fix exists to remove, not a fix for it.

provenance: D10, created 2026-08-26 before the ARIA fix, per hard rule 2. Narrative: browser-agent repo docs/evals/2026-08-24-demo-sec10k-inspector-postmortem.md section 3, remediation item 3.
